proposals.text: Proposed for any incident meeting these policy conditions: check or prepare the unsent notification to Operations Duty Manager and recovery team within 15 minutes of threshold detection. Human confirmation required; not executed.

Proposed for any incident meeting these policy conditions: check or prepare the unsent notification to Customer Service Lead within 30 minutes of threshold detection. Human confirmation required; not executed.

Proposed for any incident meeting these policy conditions: prepare the first customer notice within 30 minutes of threshold detection; propose subsequent updates at least every 60 minutes while impact continues. Human confirmation required; not executed.

Proposed for any incident meeting these policy conditions: if review is mandatory, schedule it within 5 business days of resolution and publish the draft within 10 business days. Confirm the absent holiday calendar before calculating calendar dates. Human confirmation required; not executed.
